messages.subject: Problems INLA cygwin
parts:
Hello everybody.

I am having problems running inla. This is the message. 

What can I do to sole this. I have installed cygwin.


"Error in inla.cygwin.run.command(paste("cygpath -u ", inla.cygwin.protect.special.chars(filename)),  : 
  Cannot find the CYGWIN installation: C:/cygwin"

Thanks

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Problems INLA cygwin
parts:
you have to define where cygwin is installed using

library(INLA)
inla.setOption(cygwin="C:/cygwin")

which is the default

H
